text: G42 counts Mubadala, Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund, as an investor and is chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, a member of Abu Dhabi's ruling family.

source.name: Reuters (via Yahoo Finance): Mubadala-backed AI firm G42 sets up $10 billion tech fund
